normalized.result:
The basic finding flow feels right, and selecting multiple tags should narrow to bookmarks carrying both. Search and tag filters combining also matches my expectation.

For search, I want it to be case-insensitive and cover the title, description, note, and URL. Including tags and the site name too is fine. I’d also like `#tag` searches, quoted exact phrases, and more precise searches using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.
